description: This file implements a simulation of the Enigma machine encryption algorithm, including character encoding, wheel rotation, and path calculation functions.

methods.name: enig_enc
methods.description: Encrypts a character using Enigma machine simulation and updates wheel positions.

methods.name: calc_rev_wheel
methods.description: Calculates the reverse path for a wheel, returning success or error.

methods.name: char_to_index
methods.description: Converts a lowercase letter to an index 0-25.

methods.name: index_to_char
methods.description: Converts an index 0-25 back to a lowercase letter.

methods.name: update_wheel_index
methods.description: Advances the wheel positions simulating rotation after each character encryption.
